mistake_reason: At step 6, RealityTVDataVerification_Expert reviewed the CSV output that explicitly listed two May-born winners (Fabio Birza: 1989-05-13 and Michele Fitzgerald: 1990-05-05) but only communicated Fabio Birza to the team, withholding the critical insight that Michele Fitzgerald is also May-born. This information withholding led the rest of the agents to perform validation and uniqueness checks centered solely on Fabio, ignoring Michele. The subsequent partial spot-checks reinforced a false uniqueness assumption, causing the team to produce the wrong answer. This aligns with FM-2.4 (Information Withholding): the agent concealed essential data seen in the dataset, which materially impacted downstream decision-making.
